# Conformance vectors of version 2 of the canonical encoding of a capture class,
# nvx::host::template::CaptureClass, which the module nvx::host::template describes. README.md
# describes the line format and the rules that the vectors follow.
#
# CLASS|NAME|BYTES|IDENTITY
#   The canonical encoding of a class, and its identity: the SHA-256 digest of "nvx capture class",
#   a NUL byte, and the encoding. An encoder must encode the class to the bytes.
#
# Version 2 holds what version 1 held after its version, then the kernel tuning parameters, a list
# of texts. The classes are those of the captures that template-key-v1.txt names, with the
# OpenVMM, kernel, and initramfs identities sha256:a..., sha256:b..., and sha256:c..., the guest
# build guest-build-1, boot contract 3, control contract nvx-microvm-v2-control-v2, control
# session 1, snapshot format 6, device-state schema 1, time ABI 1, restore packet 4, and
# activation contract 1.
# The class of the capture of TEMPLATE: the CPU profile auto, and 2 processors, all online at
# boot, without kernel tuning parameters.
CLASS|TEMPLATE||e875bc416862b2713b15c52a28ae474d78f1a78638748ef233eae9e34a4c8ecc
# The class of the capture of NETWORK, whose NIC the capture attaches under the complete
# deny-all policy, whatever the policy of the class's network, here one that allows egress,
# without kernel tuning parameters.
CLASS|NETWORK||cd1a67bbeeb1322901e2c617a06856d8c5c9bea41e3c4f35c624580cb794c3da
# The class of TEMPLATE with the kernel tuning parameters mitigations=auto,nosmt,
# no_timer_check, quiet, and loglevel=0, in that order.
CLASS|TUNING||35871b8eca507e82f2ee9434e5dfd828f7853adbc0b7f3a4b7a229afba55d2ba
